title: Coinbase assessment source operation is ambiguous within one run
description: The required schema-v2 assessment for security_37ddcbdaad296ad831f2 could not be written. The deterministic assessment applier found both predecessor quick_check_research 01KZK71T2KJ283D4X2FK8BP9CK and current security_research 01KZM7W5C8C2YW24Q3J4JNJ0MS claimed by run daily-20260809T212714Z and rejects more than one same-security source operation as ambiguous. The assessment request has no source-operation selector, so this routed operation cannot repair provenance without an out-of-scope code or queue/history change.
